    METHOD NOTES

    How to read this dashboard

    01

    Sentiment gap

    Observed Michigan headline sentiment minus the expanding-window, economic-only OLS forecast. The shaded band is a conformal prediction interval based only on earlier one-step errors.

    02

    Media measures

    Tone is positive share minus negative share. Salience uses primary-topic shares. Framing is multi-label incidence. Calibration is reported only when a numerical claim can be compared with the reference workbook.

    03

    Timing

    Monthly analysis begins in January 2010. Forecast evaluation begins in August 2023. Quarterly GDP remains quarterly and enters forecasts only after a conservative proxy release date.

    04

    Causal language

    Associations, prediction gains, and threshold-IV estimates are shown separately. Weak instruments, reverse causality, shared shocks, and exposure uncertainty prevent a national causal claim.
